sv.title: Polisens varning inför Black week
sv.summary: Under Black week vill många passa på göra ett klipp eller kanske hitta en tidig julklapp till pangpris.Nu varnar dock polisen för att även bedragare ser sin chans.

en.title: Police warning ahead of Black Week
en.summary: During Black Week, many want to take the chance to make a cut or perhaps find an early Christmas present at a bargain price. But the police now warn that fraudsters also see their chance.
